item.subject: maths
item.stem:
The diagram shows right triangle PQR with right angle at P. Imran measures $PQ = PR = 6$ cm and wants the relation for the hypotenuse $c$.

Which statement is correct?

options.B: The hypotenuse equals 6 cm, renaming the equal legs as if they were already the hypotenuse.
options.C: Equal legs are produced only after $c^2 = 2a^2$ is known, so the side lengths cannot start the relation.
options.D: Choose $c = 6$ because 6 is the number printed on both legs.
